note.en: TODO verify per university: these are GENERIC subject-choice guidance, so every entry sits in recommendedHL and requiredHL is deliberately empty. requiredHL is reserved for rules verified at the level of a specific university + programme + entry year; until such data exists the tool must not tell a family that a subject is 'required'. Entry routes differ by country - e.g. New Zealand school leavers enter medicine through a first-year university programme.
note.zh: 待逐校核实：这些是「通用选课参考」，因此全部放在 recommendedHL，requiredHL 刻意留空。requiredHL 只保留给「具体大学 + 具体专业 + 入学年份」级别、已核实的规则；在拿到这类数据之前，本工具不应告诉家长某门课是「必需」的。各国入口不同——例如新西兰高中毕业生是通过大学一年级课程入读医学。

note.en: Generic guidance only. In New Zealand, school leavers cannot apply directly to a medical degree - entry is through a first-year university programme, and the high-school subjects are recommendations rather than hard requirements. Some countries expect three HL sciences. Always check the target university's own page.
note.zh: 仅为通用参考。在新西兰，高中毕业生不能直接申请医学学位——须通过大学一年级课程入读，高中科目多为建议而非硬性要求。部分国家要求三门 HL 理科。务必查看目标大学官网。

note.en: Generic guidance only: most engineering schools expect Mathematics AA rather than AI, and usually HL Physics. Requirements differ by university and programme - always check the official page.
note.zh: 仅为通用参考：多数工程学院要求数学 AA 而非 AI，通常还要 HL 物理。各校各专业要求不同，务必查看官网。

note.en: Mathematics AA is usually preferred. Subject to each university/programme.
note.zh: 通常优先 数学 AA。以各大学/专业官网为准。

note.en: HL Mathematics or HL Economics is the common starting point. Subject to each university/programme.
note.zh: 常见起点是 HL 数学 或 HL 经济。以各大学/专业官网为准。

note.en: No fixed subject requirement; language and humanities HLs (History, English Literature) are common. Subject to each university/programme.
note.zh: 无固定科目要求；语言与人文 HL（历史、英语文学）常见。以各大学/专业官网为准。

note.en: Take the matching science at HL; HL Mathematics AA helps. Subject to each university/programme.
note.zh: 对应学科取 HL；HL 数学 AA 加分。以各大学/专业官网为准。

note.en: Some schools require a portfolio and/or Visual Arts. Subject to each university/programme.
note.zh: 部分学校要求作品集和/或视觉艺术。以各大学/专业官网为准。

note.en: A portfolio is normally required. Subject to each university/programme.
note.zh: 通常需要作品集。以各大学/专业官网为准。

note.en: One humanities HL (Psychology, History or Economics). Subject to each university/programme.
note.zh: 人文 HL 择一（心理、历史或经济）。以各大学/专业官网为准。

note.en: Keep the most doors open: a balanced combination including HL Mathematics.
note.zh: 保持最多门开放：含 HL 数学的均衡组合。
